proposals.quote: Bally’s has committed to comprehensive infrastructure improvements, including construction of a new overpass over the Hutchinson River Parkway, reconstruction of Ferry Point Park Ring Road to two lanes and adding sidewalks, improved pedestrian facilities, expanded Ferry Point Park bike paths, and adding an MTA bus stop at Ferry Point and two bus stops at Bally’s Bronx location.
Bally’s also promised to provide direct pedestrian and bicycle connections between the facility, Ferry Point Park, and the Ferry Point waterfront and to expand the ferry shuttle service.

Bally’s will coordinate with state and city agencies to manage traffic impacts. Specific examples of traffic mitigants include flaggers, optimize traffic signaling, and coordinating with existing Ferry Point access roads to minimize disruption from material deliveries.

The closing of the transactions contemplated by the Conveyance Agreement occurred in February 2026 and was contingent upon, among other things, (i) Bally’s New York’s agreement to (a) make certain capital improvements to Ferry Point Park in the Bronx, NY with a fair market value of approximately $161 million and (b) to deliver security instruments to the City to secure the performance and completion of such capital improvements,
Bally’s New York must spend $161 million in capital improvements to Ferry Point Park to be completed within 7 years after closing.

Since September 2023 Bally’s has offered shuttle service with 10 stops, including stops at the Bally’s Golf Links at Ferry Point and various stops between the Throggs Neck neighborhood and the Westchester Square 6-Train Subway station.
the proposed integrated facility would provide space for an MTA bus stop on-site, as well as a bus stop along the proposed reconstructed Ring Road in Ferry Point Park for Park users.

physical infrastructure improvements such as the proposed Lafayette overpass, widening of ring road and restriping and signalizing of certain intersections would have a significant positive impact on not only project transit and circulation, but also for the broader Bronx community as well.

Preliminary discussions have been held with MTA regarding potential extension of bus lines to the Project Site and with NYCEDC regarding potential for increased ferry service to the Ferry Point Park ferry landing.
Commitments for increased service for the MTA bus stops are in place, but specific details will need to be further materialized.

Currently, Bally’s operates a shuttle bus between this stop and the golf course. In December 2021, New York City ferry service began with the opening of a new landing on the western side of Ferry Point Park.
